name: areAllCriticalGapsTriaged
definition: True when every gap with severity level critical or high carries an Exploit Path Verification verdict that a person accepted and that reached a conclusion.
population: gaps in the collection whose severity.level is critical or high
evidenceRequiredForTrue: At least one critical or high gap, and every one of them with an accepted verdict other than indeterminate. No critical or high gap is not evidence that criticals were triaged.

changeLog.change: Registered with the Exploit Path Verification transforms; proposed, no requirement reads it yet.

notes: Input is Spektrum's own Exploit Path Verification output (verdicts on gap tokens, Integration-Service src/schemas/epv.py), not a vendor response. An accepted verdict is an analyst's attestation over an analysis Spektrum computed, so the transform reports proofLevel 1: the party that produced the analysis cannot also certify it. Only verdicts with reviewState accepted count; pending, rejected, superseded and accepted-indeterminate verdicts settle nothing. allowedCategories is empty because gap verdicts are cross-category evidence (a passport's gaps span every safeguard category); no integration answers these keys today, so no RTA row maps them yet.
